subject.title: [Feature]: Control UI should show compact run progress for long or multi-agent tasks

question: What canonical activity/progress contract should the Control UI use for long or multi-agent runs: the full gateway session activity/attention API, a narrower UI-only strip, or a staged subset?
rationale: The gap is real, but the remaining work defines user-visible phase semantics and likely public Gateway/session events rather than a narrow bug repair; open PRs also disagree on scope and remain unmerged.

options.title: Approve gateway-backed activity contract
options.body: Define activity/attention fields, event/resync behavior, and the minimal Control UI strip before merging implementation work.

options.title: Narrow to UI-only interim strip
options.body: Allow a smaller Control UI presentation using existing coarse events while keeping the broader Gateway activity API tracked separately.

options.title: Pause behind broader API issue
options.body: Keep this issue open but defer UI work until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127 settles the backend contract.

recommendation.title: Approve gateway-backed activity contract
recommendation.body: Define activity/attention fields, event/resync behavior, and the minimal Control UI strip before merging implementation work.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned to the canonical Gateway activity-contract issue and has recent Gateway/protocol-adjacent history.
